preferences: Claude Opus is the right choice for anything artistic or human-skill-oriented: copywriting, naming, UX copy, visual design, styling, and planning work whose output is prose a human has to read. Codex is the workhorse for mechanical work: implementation against a settled design, mass refactors, and audits where the answer is a checklist rather than a judgment call.

Values are provider/model pairs, split on the first slash. The provider half must be an id from `paseo provider ls`; the model half must be an id from `paseo provider models <provider>`. A bare provider id is rejected by create_agent.
Prefer asynchronous delegation. Leave notifyOnFinish at its default and move on rather than polling list_agents or get_agent_status.
